items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: Yes, I had Tom Whaley. ... So I told Tom Whaley you going to conduct this band, see?

ctx.x: Well just before we finish off here. After this thing with Ally Ross he says here, led own band at the La Fayette. You led your own band?
Yes. Yes, I had Tom Whaley.
